name: reader-scenario-attribution
goal: Recorded evidence readers are attributed to two headless scenarios whose existing integration tests are observed through the unchanged verification wrapper

evidence: 27 recorded-evidence reader units had no scenario, so an entity could show no recorded behaviour. Expected: two headless scenarios, one per package, whose existing integration tests are observed by the unchanged wrapper and attributed to the units they exercise

The wrapper refused both names with Unknown verification scenario, runner, target or package (exit 1), and 27 reader units listed no scenario: /tmp/harness-reader-scenarios-red.log. Before-hashes of tests, sources and wrapper: /tmp/harness-reader-scenarios-before.txt

Scenarios desktop-recorded-evidence and hub-recorded-evidence; test/recorded-evidence-scopes.ts with every test name mapped to a state; three Hub tests import the instrumented expect; 48 unit manifests attributed, 11 reader contracts declare their refusals. No production source changed

Dirty-tree smoke only: six wrapper runs exit 0 under HARNESS_SCENARIO; both scenarios have output and assertion captures for 9 of 9 states; 14 and 19 tests observed, all passed, none pending (/tmp/harness-reader-scenarios-green.log). Hub 423 tests, root and Hub types, lint, prettier and units check pass. Not a sealed clean run

title: Credit only units whose functions the scenario tests execute

evidence: V8 coverage of the scenario tests: hub-artifact-commit only evaluated and media-facts never loaded in Hub tests, so both left hub-recorded-evidence; the types-only desktop-evidence-types left the desktop scenario. Controller test added as state http-boundary; HubApiController and HubProjectionService credited. Seven wrapper runs exit 0 on the dirty tree: 9 and 10 states with output and assertions, 14 and 25 tests passed (/tmp/harness-reader-scenarios-green2.log)
